Q: In a laser printer, what is the imaging drum?
Option2: A photoconductive cylinder that holds the electrostatic image before toner is applied

Q: What does the fuser assembly do in a laser printer?
Option2: Heats and presses toner onto paper to make the image permanent

Q: What is a transfer belt/transfer roller used for?
Option1: Move paper to the output tray only
Option2: Carry or apply toner from the drum(s) to the paper during the transfer step

Q: What do pickup rollers and separation pads do?
Option2: Feed a single sheet and prevent doubles from entering the path

Q: What is the duplexing assembly?
Option2: Mechanism that turns paper to allow two-sided printing in the device

Q: Which list shows the laser imaging process in order?
Option1: Charging → exposing → developing → transferring → fusing → cleaning → processing
Option2: Processing → charging → exposing → developing → transferring → fusing → cleaning
Option3: Developing → charging → exposing → fusing → transferring → cleaning
Option4: Processing → developing → charging → exposing → fusing → cleaning → transferring

Q: What does a typical laser maintenance kit include?
Option2: Fuser, rollers, separation pads, and feed components to restore reliability

Q: What is the correct ongoing maintenance for a laser device?
Option2: Replace toner as needed, apply maintenance kits per page count, calibrate, and clean

Q: Inkjet printers use which consumables?
Option2: Ink cartridges and sometimes user-replaceable print heads

Q: What does inkjet 'calibration' usually adjust?
Option2: Print head alignment and color accuracy

Q: A user reports streaking on an inkjet. First action?
Option2: Run the built-in print head cleaning routine and alignment; inspect/replace cartridges if needed

Q: What is the carriage belt in an inkjet?
Option2: Belt that moves the print head carriage across the page

Q: What is thermal printing media?
Option2: Special heat-sensitive paper used by thermal printers

Q: What component creates images in a direct-thermal printer?
Option2: Heating element that darkens the thermal paper

Q: What is typical maintenance for thermal printers?
Option2: Replace paper, clean the heating element, and remove debris

Q: Why does thermal paper need careful storage?
Option2: Heat and light can darken the coating and fade prints over time

Q: What are the main consumables for impact (dot-matrix) printers?
Option2: Print head, ribbon, and tractor-feed paper

Q: What maintenance resolves light characters on an impact printer?
Option2: Replace the ribbon and check head alignment

Q: In a 3-D filament printer, what are common consumables?
Option2: Filament spools (for example, PLA/ABS) and print bed surfaces/tape

Q: What is a resin 3-D printer’s key consumable?
Option2: Photosensitive liquid resin

Q: Which scenario best matches a failing laser fuser?
Option2: Pages smear/rub off easily and feel warm

Q: Which component replacement most likely fixes ghosting (faint repeated images) on laser prints?
Option2: Replace or clean the imaging drum and ensure proper cleaning step; inspect fuser if repeating at its circumference

Q: A duplex print jams only when printing two-sided. Likely part to inspect first?
Option2: Duplexing assembly rollers and sensors
